title: Grays, tall whites and Norwegians arrived on Earth at different points in the ice age

tellings.quote: Um, consider I'm certain that the grays got here first and they were here before the last ice age and that the tall whites got here second

plain: A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall, white-skinned aliens at Area 51, the secret test site in Nevada, says different alien groups reached Earth at different points in the ice ages. He tells Michels he is "certain that the grays got here first and they were here before the last ice age". In his account the tall whites came second, and the "Norwegians", Nordic-looking beings, came at yet another time, which would make Earth a place several visiting peoples have shared for a very long time.
